stale_rows.stated_choice: Select checkpoint_best.pyth by highest validation accuracy at each VAL_FRE_ITER checkpoint.
stale_rows.actual: The train/eval path calls build_loader(cfg, "test"); Few_shot uses the test-list dataset for that split. TEST_SET: val is ignored. Thus checkpoint_best is selected by test-list accuracy, not by an independent validation split.
stale_rows.why_it_matters: This changes model-selection/test leakage and therefore the meaning of the reported result; A-008 declares the test-list loader, so A-007's earlier validation wording was stale.
